promptFixes: Signature: (c) is not fixed. The rule measures the wrong box, a spec gap. In Signature 3 → Limits, measure the drawing, not the svg: 'Size is the drawn figure: crop the viewBox to the figure's bounding box plus at most 8% padding (compute it from the slab geometry: x from cx−w to cx+w, y from the top vertex to the bottom of the lowest slab plus its shadow). Measure `svg.querySelector("g").getBoundingClientRect().width`: in a row of three each figure is at least 240px wide at 1440px and at least 85% of its column on mobile; a figure narrower than 80% of its svg box is a failure.' In Verification, replace 'Measure every blueprint' with 'Measure the drawn group of every blueprint (not the svg) at 1440px and 390px and report the widths.' Evidence: blog/20261017-144800/screenshots/about-desktop-dark.png (figures about 188px inside 280px boxes; shots.json → drawings 280×233, identical to rc.3) vs reference/illustrations/p1-i5.png (about 245px of 291).

Signature: the about row became three look-alike stacks; spec gap. In Signature 3 → Where, add: 'The three blueprints of a row show three different subjects and constructions: at least one connected pair with a marching connector, and no two drawings that differ only in slab count; tier-style 1/2/3 stacks are reserved for plan cards.' Evidence: blog/drawings/about-d1/d2/d3.png (1, 2 and 3 slabs) and settings/drawings/settings-billing-d1..d3.png (the same motif) vs rc.3 blog/drawings/about-d2.png (pair plus connector).

Polish: mobile nav clips with the current page hidden; spec gap. In Navigation → Sidebar, replace 'Under breakpoint.lg: a pill row that scrolls inside itself' with: 'Under breakpoint.lg: a pill row; if all items fit at 390px (text only, no icons under breakpoint.sm), show them all; otherwise it scrolls inside itself with a 24px fade mask at the overflowing edge, and on load the current item is scrolled into view (`scrollIntoView({inline:"nearest"})`). No pill is ever cut by the screen edge without the fade.' Add to Verification: 'At 390px the current nav item is fully visible on every screen.' Evidence: dashboard/team-mobile-dark.png (Team off-screen, a sliver of the active pill at the right edge) and settings/settings-security-mobile-dark.png ('Bi') vs rc.3 0.1.0-rc.3/dashboard/20261017-095917/screenshots/team-mobile-dark.png (all four visible).
